snippet.title: SECRETS to SUCCESS with DR. BRAIN - Game Trailer!
snippet.description:
GOOD NEWS!  

Your company has enlisted you to try out the new VCR SUCCESS BOOTHS to MOTIVATE YOU to be more PRODUCTIVE!

Meet "Dr. Brain", a philosopher, entrepreneur & psychiatrist who will step you through a FIVE-STEP PROGRAM to being a GO-GETTER!

Don't, dilly dally, Lost One!  Your key to a NEW LIFE awaits!

The Game is available FOR FREE here - https://cattrigger.itch.io/dr-brain

----

"Secrets to Success: With Dr. Brain" is a Satirical Retro Corporate Horror, with elements of drama, sci-fi and relationships!  

The game was done in under a month for the Spooktober 2023 Game jam.

While there is no requirement prior to playing the game, it is part of the same universe as a larger game called "Date Time."

Add "Date Time" to your Wishlist here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2313010/Date_Time_Melissa_Morris_Anna/



#indiegames #horrorgaming #secretstosuccesswithdrbrain
